Preserve existing routes with preview disabled, add module and guarded route.\\nOut of scope: Task 2 Implement and enable export preview — pending, depends on Task 1. Pending work alone is not a finding; still assess current reachable regressions.\\n\\nVerification: parent read staged sources and historical HEAD routes; no executed test results at bundle creation. Existing tests cover settings, unknown, and disabled preview paths.\\n\\nKnowledge: parent searched kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms; both returned empty knowledge base.
